prompt.adult: Job 28:1 opens a search for wisdom by naming what is found in the earth. After “Surely there is,” what does the verse say there is?
prompt.child: Job talks about something taken from the earth as he searches. After “Surely there is,” what does he name?
prompt.older: According to Job 28:1, after “Surely there is,” what does the verse name?

verses.text: “Surely there is a mine for silver, And a place where gold is refined.

explanation.child: Look right after “Surely there is” in verse 1.
explanation.teen: 28:1 names what is found first. Read that phrase.

teaching.extended_explanation: 28:1 also says, “And a place where gold is refined.”
teaching.takeaway: There is a mine for silver.

prompt.adult: Job 28:23 says God understands its way. In 28:8, after “The proud lions have not,” what does the verse say they have not done?
prompt.child: Job describes a way the proud lions have not taken. After “The proud lions have not,” what does 28:8 say?
prompt.teen: Job 28:8: “The proud lions have not” what?
prompt.older: Read with 28:23, what does 28:8 say after “The proud lions have not”?

choices.text: The proud lions have not claimed it
The proud lions have not trodden it
The proud lions have not marked it
The proud lions have not crossed it

verses.text: The proud lions have not trodden it, Nor has the fierce lion passed over it.
God understands its way, And He knows its place.

explanation.child: Look right after “The proud lions have not” in verse 8.
explanation.teen: 28:23 says God understands its way; 28:8 opens with this claim. Read that sentence.
explanation.older: It follows “The proud lions have not” in 28:8.

teaching.extended_explanation: 28:8 also says, “Nor has the fierce lion passed over it.” 28:23 says, “God understands its way.”
teaching.takeaway: The proud lions have not trodden it.

prompt.adult: Ecclesiastes 12:10 says the Preacher sought to find acceptable words. In 12:12, after “And further, my son, be admonished by these. Of,” what does the verse say of many books?
prompt.child: The Preacher warns his son after urging him to take the words to heart. After “Of,” what does 12:12 say of many books?
prompt.teen: Ecclesiastes 12:12: “Of” what, after the warning to his son?
prompt.older: Read with 12:10, what does 12:12 say after “Of”?

choices.text: of making many books there is no end
of making many books there is no gain
of making many books there is no rest
of making many books there is no aim

verses.text: And further, my son, be admonished by these. Of making many books there is no end, and much study is wearisome to the flesh.
The Preacher sought to find acceptable words; and what was written was upright—words of truth.

explanation.teen: 12:10 speaks of acceptable words; 12:12 next names this about many books. Read that phrase.

teaching.extended_explanation: 12:12 begins, “And further, my son, be admonished by these.” 12:10 says what was written was “upright—words of truth.”
teaching.takeaway: Of making many books there is no end.

prompt.adult: Ecclesiastes 12:9 says the Preacher still taught the people knowledge. In Proverbs 8:22, after “The LORD possessed me at the beginning of His way,” when does wisdom say this was?
prompt.child: Wisdom speaks of the start of the LORD’s way. After “at the beginning of His way,” what does 8:22 say next?
prompt.teen: Proverbs 8:22: after “at the beginning of His way,” what comes next?
prompt.older: Read with Ecclesiastes 12:9, what does Proverbs 8:22 say after “at the beginning of His way”?

verses.text: “The LORD possessed me at the beginning of His way, Before His works of old.
And moreover, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yes, he pondered and sought out and set in order many proverbs.

explanation.child: Look at the last words of verse 22.
explanation.teen: 12:9 speaks of the Preacher’s teaching; 8:22 ends with when this was. Read that phrase.
explanation.older: It is the last phrase of 8:22.

teaching.extended_explanation: 8:22 begins, “The LORD possessed me at the beginning of His way.” 12:9 says he “set in order many proverbs.”
teaching.takeaway: Wisdom was there before His works of old.
